title: Fulfilment House Due Diligence Scheme registered businesses list
text:
Use this list if you’re a trader that is not established in the UK, to check if the business that stores your goods in the UK is registered with the Fulfilment House Due Diligence Scheme.

 Contact VAT enquiries  or email notificationofnoncompliance.fulfilmenthouse@hmrc.gov.uk if you have any questions about the scheme.
changeNote: The list has been updated with 5 additions and 1 amendment.
